families.name: Incompressible internal flows
families.description: Single-phase incompressible Newtonian flow through pipes, ducts, channels, cavities, contractions and junctions with no free surface and no heat: pressure-drop, mixing, recirculation and separation in bounded internal geometry. Default family for channel/pipe/duct/cavity prompts.

families.name: External incompressible flow over bodies
families.description: Incompressible external flow around solid bodies - airfoils, vehicles, buildings, ships, cylinders, wind farms: lift, drag, wake, boundary layers and atmospheric exposure. Use when the flow is over, not through, an object.

families.name: Compressible internal / high-speed gas flows
families.description: Compressible, thermal and high-speed gas flow in ducts, tubes, nozzles, throats and reservoirs: shock waves, decompression, sonic transitions, APERIODIC transients and strong property variation in confined geometry. Use for a shock tube, converging nozzle or pressurised tank discharging.

families.name: Compressible external flow / supersonic aerodynamics
families.description: High-speed compressible flow past bodies: airfoils, wedges, cones, biconics at supersonic/hypersonic Mach numbers with attached and oblique shocks. Use for external aerodynamics with Mach > 0.3.

families.name: Buoyant, convective and radiative heat transfer
families.description: Buoyancy-driven and natural convection with radiation and thermal comfort: hot rooms, stack plumes, cavities heated from below, radiators and solar loads. Persistent gravity + temperature difference drives the flow.

families.name: Combustion and reacting / multicomponent flows
families.description: Reacting flows with species transport, flames and combustion chemistry: counter-flow flames, pool fires, engines, detonations and temperature-concentration coupling. Fields include species mass fractions plus energy/chemistry.

families.name: Free-surface / interface capturing (VOF)
families.description: Two-phase flow with a sharp interface captured by volume fraction: dam breaks, sloshing tanks, fuel-tank sloshing, waves, floating bodies, capillary rise, droplet impact and film seeding. alpha.phase field + surface tension; use for liquid-air interfaces, sloshing, wave and free-surface problems.

families.name: Multiphase Euler / dispersed two-fluid flow
families.description: Euler-Euler multiphase with inter-phase momentum, heat and mass transfer: bubble columns, fluidised beds, boiling, stirred tanks and phase change. Two or more continuous phases solved with per-phase equations.

families.name: Particle-laden flows
families.description: Dense and dilute particle-laden flow: cyclones, particle columns, fluidised particle beds and granular transport. Discrete particle phase coupled to the carrier flow.

families.name: Conjugate heat transfer / multi-region
families.description: Conjugate conduction-convection across coupled solid and fluid regions: heat exchangers, cooled electrics, coating and wall boiling. Multiple tightly-coupled regions solve separately.

families.name: Thin-film and rivulet flows
families.description: Isothermal and thermal film flows: thin liquid films, rivulets, droplets on panels and film-to-VOF coupling.

families.name: Solid mechanics / structural displacement
families.description: Solid displacement and stresses under load: beams, plates with holes, thermal stress. Lagrangian solid fields, no fluid flow.

families.name: Rotating machinery / mixers / MRF
families.description: Rotating machinery, mixers, impellers, rotors, propellers and stirred vessels modelled with MRF/SRF or mesh rotation: impeller flows, mixing tanks, rotors, wind and marine turbines.

families.name: Potential and free-surface potential flows
families.description: Inviscid potential flow and its free-surface extensions: ocean-wave free surfaces, oscillating boxes, potential cylinders. Cheap top-down flow, no boundary layers.

families.name: Moving-mesh and dynamic meshes
families.description: Motion of the mesh itself: oscillating/floating bodies, 6-DoF objects, morphing geometry, overset and sliding interfaces.

families.name: Mesh generation templates
families.description: blockMesh / snappyHexMesh topology templates: pipes, spheres, flanges, sectors and the node-arc mesh helpers. Only the mesh, not a flow solution.

families.name: Legacy tutorial compendium (pre-v13 conventions)
families.description: Older tutorial setups kept for reference: super- and subsonic corners, elbows, free-space heat exchangers, charged wires and legacy solver dictionaries (older property and turbulence dict names). Convert conventions to v13 before reuse.
